## Status

## 1. Purpose

Fresh snap-trapped material (gut, nest/burrow, soil) is untested for this pipeline in a way an established archive wouldn't have been. This pilot exists to check DNA yield, quality, and amplification success **before** the Stage 1 RR locks in committed sample numbers and analysis plan — cheap insurance against pre-registering N or a protocol that turns out to be optimistic.

## 2. Pilot sample selection

::: {.callout-note}

**PLACEHOLDER** — propose a small subset spanning conditions rather than a random handful, e.g.:

- 2–3 individuals per grid (spanning grids)
- All sample types per individual (gut, nest/burrow soil, off-grid soil,
  field blank)
- At least one sample stored via each storage route if both flash-freeze
  and interim-preservative routes end up being used (see fieldwork
  protocol §5) — so storage method itself is part of what's validated

Total pilot N: TBD once grid count is confirmed.

:::

## 3. Extraction

::: {.callout-important}

**PLACEHOLDER** — kit choice. Starting point for discussion: a PowerSoil-type kit (or equivalent) for nest/soil material, a stool-DNA kit for gut/distal colon content. Standard input mass for kits in this class is ~250 mg;
collected volumes (§5 of fieldwork protocol) leave headroom above this so duplicate/repeat extractions are possible if a first attempt fails.

:::

- Duplicate extraction where sample volume allows (working aliquot vs. archive tube — do not deplete the archive tube on a pilot)
- Record extraction kit lot per batch

## 4. Controls included in the pilot

Run alongside the pilot extractions, not deferred to the full run:

- **Kit/reagent blank** — one per extraction batch
- **PCR no-template control** — one per PCR batch
- **Mock community standard** — run through the identical pipeline, to benchmark taxonomic/quantitative accuracy before committing real samples

::: {.callout-note}

**PLACEHOLDER** — mock community source/order status (e.g. ZymoBIOMICS or equivalent) — order lead time may matter for the pilot timeline.

:::

## 5. QC metrics and pass/fail criteria

| Metric | Method | Threshold |
|---|---|---|
| DNA yield | Qubit/Nanodrop | TBD |
| Purity (260/280, 260/230) | Nanodrop | TBD |
| Amplification success | Gel check on full-length 16S primers | TBD |
| Contaminant load in blanks | Compare blank vs. sample read counts (post-pilot sequencing) | TBD |

::: {.callout-important}

**PLACEHOLDER** — actual thresholds. Worth setting these *before* seeing pilot results, not after, so they function as real decision criteria rather than post-hoc justification.

:::

## 6. Decision framework

What pilot outcomes would change before Stage 1 RR submission:

::: {.callout-note}

**PLACEHOLDER** — e.g.:

- If soil/nest yield is too low at 250 mg input → increase field-collected volume guidance, or switch extraction kit
- If off-grid or field blanks show substantial contaminant load → revisit field hygiene protocol before scaling to full N 
- If gut material shows postmortem degradation signatures → revisit trap check frequency / interim storage requirement in fieldwork protocol §5
- If a storage route (flash-freeze vs. preservative) clearly outperforms the other → standardize on it for the full campaign rather than leaving it flexible

:::

## 7. Timeline

::: {.callout-important}

**PLACEHOLDER** — pilot needs to complete (extraction → QC, not necessarily full sequencing) early enough to inform Stage 1 RR numbers. Slot this against the Phase 1 timeline once the September trapping dates are confirmed.

:::
